Marta: quick flag — I'm seeing a bunch of confusion in onboarding about how SDKs surface failures. users get opaque messages in python but a typed exception in ts. can we align?
Sahil: yeah this came up in support yesterday, customer thought a 502 was a client issue because message said 'request failed' with no hint. :grimacing:
Kevin: +1. parity across SDKs is messy. each lib names errors differently (e.g., NotFoundError vs ResourceMissingError). makes cross-language debugging painful.
Olivia: do we have a canonical mapping doc anywhere? I'd like to point customers to a simple table in the quickstart.
Marta: not really — there's a set of notes in the internal error mapping sheet but it's inconsistent. propose a small surface contract: 1) typed exceptions in SDKs with stable names, 2) user-facing message with short actionable hint, 3) status-code -> retry_hint mapping.
Sahil: sketch of mapping I used in the support reply:
```
HTTP 401 -> AuthError("invalid_api_key")  // non-retry, show link to creds page
HTTP 403 -> PermissionError("resource_denied") // non-retry, include policy hint
HTTP 404 -> NotFoundError("model_not_found") // non-retry, suggest model list API
HTTP 408/504 -> TimeoutError("upstream_timeout") // retryable (exponential backoff)
HTTP 429 -> RateLimitError("quota_exceeded") // retry-after header, advise backoff or batch
HTTP 5xx -> TransientError("server_unavailable") // retryable with jitter, escalate if persistent
```
Kevin: love this. important: include machine-readable code (e.g., "quota_exceeded") in both the exception and the message so SDK consumers can branch on it.
Marta: agreed. also want consistent telemetry fields: error.code, error.retryable (bool), error.hint_url. that helps console and support triage.
Olivia: UX note — keep user message short + one actionable next step. e.g., for 429: "Rate limit exceeded. Retry in Xs or reduce batch size. See <link>." don't dump raw server logs.
Sahil: question: should SDKs throw different language primitives (native Error subclass) or always return an error envelope object?
Kevin: throw native Error subclass and attach envelope on the instance (error.code, error.retryable, error.meta). keeps try/catch idiomatic but still machine-friendly.
Marta: ops-bot: can you add a ticket to the SDK parity board with these bullets + a short sample for python/ts? we need owners.
ops-bot: Created task RDW-UX-1245: "SDK error surface: canonical names + status mapping" assigned to @sahil, @kevin, due 2026-04-07.
Olivia: for docs: I'll add a "Failure surface" section in quickstart with a small table and examples for catching errors. want to include copy suggestions to avoid blaming customers (no "invalid request" alone).
Sahil: I'll draft the SDK changes — plan: 1) add canonical enum for codes, 2) implement http->code mapping in runtime layer, 3) surface Error subclass with props. estimate ~3 days per SDK.
Kevin: don't forget streaming paths: partial responses + chunk error should be a StreamError with fields: recoverable(bool), position(token_index).
Marta: good call. also consider auth retry hints: if KMS signature expired vs token expired we should surface specific remediation text.
Olivia: sample message suggestions (for docs):
- AuthError: "Authentication failed. Check API key or token expiry. See: /docs/auth"
- RateLimitError: "Rate limit exceeded. Retry after Xs or reduce concurrency. See: /docs/throughput"
- NotFoundError: "Requested model not found. Use /models to list available models."
Sahil: one more: standardize on including request_id in every error message and in telemetry (request_id: abc123). makes debugging across stack trivial.
Kevin: +1. also add a lint rule in SDK CI: error classes must have code + retryable + request_id attached.
Marta: next steps: Sahil + Kevin to prototype python + ts patch, Olivia to draft docs copy, I'll update internal mapping sheet and create a short announcement for dev portal. ops-bot created ticket so owners are tracked.
Olivia: happy to review copy. let's try to keep phrasing customer-friendly and avoid internal jargon.
Sahil: will post a draft PR link here when ready.
Marta: thanks all — small changes but huge DX improvement. :thumbsup:
